description: Assessment of Transport Strategies (ASTRA) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by M-Five GmbH Mobility Futures Innovation Economics, Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research (ISI), TRT Trasporti e Territorio (TRT) (only European version). ASTRA is an integrated assessment model applied since more than 20 years for strategic policy assessment in the field of transport, energy, climate and technology. A detailed national ASTRA-DE version allows the development and quantification of explorative scenarios for Germany. Coverage: Switzerland, Germany, Norway. Methodical focus: Integrative Assessment Model, System Dynamics. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: national states, regions, households. Software: The model is based on the System Dynamics approach and built in Vensim®.. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
